notes.title: The deeper the darkness — the stronger you become. The update is live.
notes.content:
Greetings, Hunters!
We’ve got great news — the update is now live, and you can jump in and experience the new gameplay right away!

The new leveling and character progression system is here!
From now on, your hero will grow with you. You’ll earn 2 attribute points per level, up to 50 levels, giving you 100 points to customize your build!

Attributes you can improve:

 Damage
 Critical Hit Chance
 Health
 Health Regeneration
 Armor Regeneration
 Mana
 Mana Regeneration

To truly test your skills and earn greater rewards, each mission features 5 difficulty levels. Accept the challenge and prove your worth.

The update is already available — jump in and start leveling up!
Thank you for staying with us.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2336760/Immortal_Hunters/

notes.title: First Update After Version 1.0!
notes.content:
Hunters, we’ve just released the first update after the official launch! This update focuses on fixing important bugs, improving gameplay, and adding new features. Thank you for your feedback—your support helps us make the game even better!

Fixes:

 Fixed a black screen bug in the "City Gates" mission.
 Removed flickering of the city image during loading.
 Fixed an issue with closing hints using a gamepad.
 Assassin's daggers now display correctly.
 Fixed the worker system in city buildings.


New Additions

 New shops have been added—now you can purchase items in various buildings around the city.
 Updated potion and consumable system—now they can be used multiple times per mission.
 Healing effects have been added for main characters.
 Random offers now appear in the potion shop.


Balance Updates

 Archer: Increased the duration of Arrow Rain.
 Assassin & Priestess: Faster cooldowns and ability animations.
 Priestess: Increased impact area for energy spheres.
 Item prices in shops have been adjusted.


We know there are still some issues that require more time to fix. We’re actively working on them and will include them in future updates!

Thank you for playing and helping us improve the game! Share your feedback—together, we’re creating something amazing!

notes.title: IMMORTAL HUNTERS 1.0
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=cxRGxK6T15c;full][/previewyoutube]
What’s New?
The long development cycle has come to an end, and we’re thrilled to share exciting news with our community: Immortal Hunters is officially live! While our programmers work on the "day-one patch" to address bug reports, let’s revisit what you’ll find in the full release — consider this a quick overview. Let’s dive in!

Hero Equipment
Until version 1.0, the gear system lacked its final polish. Now, equipment focuses less on boosting raw stats and more on adding unique mechanics (e.g., poisoning enemies). We’ve prioritized synergy over math, letting you experiment with creative gear combinations.

New Levels
Designing combat zones where heroes clash with enemies has always been one of the most labor-intensive tasks in Immortal Hunters. The full release adds two massive new levels (with increased difficulty!) and several time-limited missions.

Balance Adjustments
The game was designed as a co-op adventure where difficulty scales dynamically with player count. Fine-tuning this progression was no easy feat, but the release version includes numerous subtle balance tweaks to make gameplay more predictable (in the best way!). If you crave a challenge, use the skull-shaped buttons before starting a mission to crank up the difficulty!

Text Quests
We added this feature to weave narrative setup for certain missions, but its main purpose is to tell small-scale stories that unfold alongside the main plot. These quests force players to make choices — often leading to unpredictable consequences. Until the final version, this system didn’t function properly, but we’ve fixed it all: resources are deducted/added correctly, and the mighty random now delivers surprising plot twists. We’ve also included additional text quests to expand the world of Immortal Hunters.


What’s Next?
We’ve spent years crafting Immortal Hunters, and its future matters as much to us as its present. Here’s our strategy for upcoming updates and improvements:

Small Patches First: we’ll roll out incremental updates with tweaks and fixes (not just bugs!).

Long-Term Plans: It’s too early to share details, but the full release is just the beginning. Prepare for thrilling co-op matches, gear collection, and bone-crushing challenges!

Thank you for your support! Stay connected and be the first to hear about updates: follow our Steam community.

Happy hunting,
Your Admiral Games team.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2336760/Immortal_Hunters/?beta=0

notes.title: New update: gamepad support, new localizations, and more!
notes.content:
Since the release of Immortal Hunters in Early Access, we have promised full gamepad support for a seamless and immersive gaming experience. And it's finally there — now the game supports controllers!

This took more effort than it might seem, and the patch was delayed due to some differences in playable characters mechanics. Anyway, now we are happy with the result. There are also minor changes in keyboard controls, you can make your character crouch by pressing the "S" button (by default, you can also change it in a settings menu). 

Sometimes real chaos happens on the battleground, and we have made efforts to make character and enemies conditions more clear: status effects such as bleeding, poisoning, stunning are now displayed on all heroes and monsters. The crosshair design for ranged attacks has also changed and now it is tied to the character and has become more informative.

We also received lots of requests to make Immortal Hunters available in other languages, so we added translations for Chinese (Simplified), Spanish, Portuguese and German players. Localizations may contain some errors and inaccuracies, and we are open to your comments and corrections.

Here is the brief patch changelog:

 Controller support.
 Localization into Chinese (simplified), Spanish, Portuguese and German.
 Bleeding, poisoning, stunning, etc are now displayed on enemies and characters.
 Fixed a number of minor bugs.


Join our discord community, leave a review, and of course, play Immortal Hunters on your controller! Thank you for being with us!

We stay in touch and will be back soon with more updates.

notes.title: Co-Op with friends!
notes.content:
Just three weeks after launching into Early Access we’re bringing some major news…

The game now has online co-op!

You will be able to invite up to three friends to your team to conquer dungeons and forests in the vicinity of Inholm. The help of friends will be very useful on some levels with the number and strength of enemy hordes.

To dive into co-op mode click on the mission you want to go on from the map as the host. From there you can invite friends to the team using the button in the lower-left corner of the screen. Participants share rewards, but only the host advances in the plot — so you can complete the game only by being the host in the entire chain of missions (a good reason to beat the game again!)

Co-op opens up many new possibilities. A team of Hunters can become truly indestructible if you learn to combine the characters' abilities on the battlefield like blocking enemies with Orin's ice wall while Lyria charges energy spheres. Or slow down advancing enemies with Rhona's shots so Jakub can charge into the crowd with his ultimate punch... And of course, playing in a team allows you to resurrect fallen allies, so your partners become much more useful!

We’ve done more than just add co-op mode! Here is a full list of changes and fixes included in this patch:

 Added and configured Co-Op mode for 4 players.
 Improved optimization.
 Updated monster AI.
 Added hints/tutorials for the city and map.
 Fixed visual bugs with missing background.
 Added a difficulty system.
 Added missing sounds.
 Fixed repair/resurrection logic.
 Fixed non adjustable sounds.
 Fixed inventory.
 Improved graphics in the city.
 Fixed many fonts.
 Fixed a bug with repair.


We would like to remind you that reviews are very important for indie games. Our game is no exception, so we will be waiting for your honest reviews! If you haven't purchased a copy of Immortal Hunters yet, now is a great time to hop in with your friends and experience the game together.

notes.title: Right now: Immortal Hunters is out in Early Access!
notes.content:
We have been waiting for this moment like no other — the gates of the gloomy world, where the flame of human civilization barely glimmers, and legions of underground undead storm the cities, are finally open! Would you dare to enter? Choose one of the four immortal Hunters and act in defense of the human race.

Have you seen our trailer yet? Watch it now, if not! :)
[previewyoutube=S6M1uc0--yo;full][/previewyoutube]

Immortal Hunters has only been released into early access — this is just the beginning of a long journey, and we will be happy to go through it with you. Let us remind you what the EA version of Immortal Hunters is. Here are the key features:

 Hardcore, fast-paced beat'em up
 This is gonna be sweaty and bloody. Just find your own tactics to resist the hordes of evil beasts.
 Dozens of different opponents
 They can explode, dodge your blows, run along walls, breathe fire and spit poison.
 Cart missions
 A real Hunter always has an armored cart with a unique set of abilities at his disposal. An excellent tool for escaping pursuit when crowds of demons are on your heels.
 Stylish 2D graphics
 We love fantasy and comics, we like the visual laconicism of early beat'em ups and the artistry of 2D games. That's why Immortal Hunters looks the way it does.
 Many mechanics
 Despite the fact that the core-gameplay is beat'em up, we are trying to make a truly multifaceted game. Not all of the gameplay mechanics work in early access, but there are enough of those already available to make the gameplay as varied as possible! In addition to foot battles and carriage rides, you will have to participate in text quests, prove your case in dialogues, rebuild a destroyed city and study the weak points of numerous enemies...


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2336760/Immortal_Hunters/

Join the adventure now. It may not be easy (it's early access, after all!), but it's definitely exciting and fun. In addition, there is a 10% launch discount, which will last for 2 weeks (up to 24th of September).

Early bird feedback is important to us, so yes, we will be happy to see your honest review: tell us if you like the game or not, report a bug, help with advice and offer your ideas. But this is not the only way to support us...

How You Can Support Us
As a small indie team, there are so many ways you can help support us and the game.
 Sharing the game through word of mouth with family and friends or on social media with your followers can really help spread the word and give others a chance to discover their next adventure. So many indies are discovered with a simple share or casual discussion.
 Join the amazing community in our Discord to share your thoughts.
 The wishlist trick still works: if you don't plan to buy the game at the moment, add us to your wishlist, this will make Immortal Hunters more visible for the other players.

notes.title: The dead God and tons of underground beasts…
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=VsGzuXitmew;full][/previewyoutube]

Admiral games and indie.io are proud to inform you that Immortal Hunters will be released into early access on September 10th!

We've been waiting for this moment for so long and we hope you've been waiting for it with us! Add the game to your wishlist so you don't miss the release. The city of Inholm stands in the way of the dark forces' invasion, but as long as the sacred Fires burn, there is still hope...

CHOOSE YOUR HUNTER
Immortal Hunters are undead who fight on the side of the Church to help all of the human world to stay safe. Choose your fighter: a powerful warrior wielding ice magic, an arrogant ranger who can ignite arrows and explode enemies, a master of illusion with two knives, or a sorceress who emerges from her body as a vengeful ghost. Each has their own unique abilities and their own fighting style.

FIGHT THROES OF ENEMIES
You'll really need the help of Hunters to defeat the legions of Khemrids - underground creatures who want to destroy humanity. You will be met by hundreds of enemies armed with fangs, claws, dark magic and dirty tricks. Some of the enemies you have to face are exploding poisonous bugs, walking piles of flesh breathing fire, and two-headed monsters who suddenly strike from underground.

DRIVE YOUR CARRIAGE
Sometimes, there are just too many enemies and an armored cart will come to your aid. This is a self-propelled carriage powered by the energy of holy Fires. Use the cart’s abilities (each Hunter has their own!) to fight off the evil monsters chasing you. Fight and don't let your enemies break your cart!

LEARN A LOT OF MECHANICS
The gameplay of Immortal Hunters provides many options: fight enemies, rebuild the city, participate in text quests, and make decisions that will one day affect the future of the city of Inholm.

Thank you for being with us all this time. Add Immortal Hunters to your wishlist if you haven't already and join our community on Steam. Since the game is still in early access, the most interesting things are yet to come: we are already working on skill tree, co-operative gameplay, an equipment system, and much more!

See you on the battlefield.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2336760/Immortal_Hunters/
